structured.answer: I'd go with option 1, where each company sits at the start of its row. The S&P 500 group came up first, and in one short list I could see the names I know (הראל, מגדל, כלל, מנורה) with their fee and return next to each other. I'm fairly sure, but the page still didn't tell me where to put my 30,000 ₪, and "קופת גמל להשקעה" still sounds like something for older people.

stuck.where: Top of the page, the three buttons "1. החברה בראש השורה" / "2. קיבוץ לפי חבר" / "3. טבלת חברות מול סוגים" (מומלץ)
stuck.why: At first I didn't get that these were three versions of the same list. The third one says "מומלץ", so I almost picked it without looking.

It's an endless list of every הראל track. Most of them are things I don't care about (אג"ח, הלכה, כספי). I scrolled for ages before I reached מור and never got to the other companies. I was bored by this point.
A wall of percentages in brown and orange. I couldn't tell what the colors meant (I guessed darker or orange means more expensive), and it felt like homework.
Some companies have no return at all, like אלטשולר and ילין. I couldn't tell whether that's bad or just new.

used: The big heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות"
Company names in bold at the start of each row
The ₪ figures for assets ("674 מיליון ₪", "2.3 מיליארד ₪")
The heat-map table in option 3, as a quick glance
skimmed: The intro line under the heading
The product and track chips (תגמולים, קרן השתלמות, ...)
The חשיפה column with the rings (מניות / מט"ח)
The long הראל and מור lists in option 2
skipped: Grey explanation paragraphs between the options
The "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link
The "משותף לשלוש, ומה שהנתונים מראים" link
The bottom of option 3 ("כל המסלולים" again)
unsure_meaning: דמי ניהול מההפקדה vs ההחיסכון: is it two fees?
חשיפה, and the rings with מניות / מט"ח percentages
The colors in the option-3 table (brown vs orange)
Whether the ₪ figure is something I'd pay or the size of the fund
not_found: How much the fee would cost me in shekels on 30,000 ₪
What to actually do first, like a button to join or open
Whether I can add a few hundred a month
A plain answer to which company is best for me

findings.what: Fees are shown only as percents (0.52%, 0.71%), so they all look like nothing. There's no shekel figure for what I'd pay.
Option 3 is marked "מומלץ" but it's the hardest to read: a grid of percents in colors nobody explains to me.
Option 2 makes me scroll through every track of one company before I can compare companies on the one thing I want, S&P.
The biggest ₪ numbers are the companies' assets. They stick in my head, but they don't tell me anything useful.
Some companies show "פחות מ־3 שנים" instead of a return, so I can't compare them.
findings.where: Return column, אלטשולר, אינפיניטי, ילין, איילון

findings.what: Two fee numbers per row (החיסכון and ההפקדה) with no explanation
I couldn't easily tell where one option ends and the next begins. The same header and tabs repeat three times.
